answer: Multiple customer signals and studies directly contradict the acceptance criteria: frequent CarPlay/Android Auto pairing and drop issues; repeated complaints that the wireless pad charges slowly, fails or is poorly sized; built‑in Wi‑Fi reported as slow/unreliable; and voice recognition has notable accuracy complaints and poor study scores. Phone/case diversity and carrier/eSIM activation are recurring limiting factors. These data argue the criteria are optimistic without tighter scope or test controls.
suggested_change: Make acceptance conditional: require validation on a defined representative matrix of current top-selling phones and cases and under specified carrier/network conditions; explicitly exclude failures due to incompatible phone OS/protocol or carrier limitations. Update charging criterion to require ≥7.5 W for compatible phones and state success as percentage of the tested compatible phone+case matrix; add test definitions for ‘suburban’ cellular conditions for Wi‑Fi hotspot testing.
